lead_raw_text:
The Ho2Mn2Ge4 structure (reduced formula HoMnGe2) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ge centers with 9 geometric neighbors (2 Ge, 1 Ho, 6 Mn) and Ho centers with 16 neighbors (8 Ge, 4 Ho, 4 Mn), while Mn centers have 12 neighbors (8 Ge, 4 Mn) in a close-packed-like local arrangement. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Ge and Ho coordination polyhedra, and corner/face sharing between Ge and Mn polyhedra.
